technique_name: Write a history of artificial intelligence
description: The history of artificial intelligence began in the 1950s, with the development of early computers and the first attempts to create programs that could make decisions on their own. Early successes in the creation of chess-playing computers and automated theorem-proving programs paved the way for further research.
